title: Fleet telemetry: decoding the gateway's wire format
name: Telemetry wire codec

questions.prompt: Since we moved trucks onto the new cellular gateway, the dispatcher map has gone blank for those trucks. The ingest endpoint answers 200, but every reading in a gateway batch comes back in `rejected` with reason "stale". Trucks still on the old firmware show up fine. The partner fuel report is also missing all gateway trucks. Fix wire.ts so the tests pass.
